hud_and_control_optimizations.aim_assist: When target lock is on a knocked-down enemy, crosshair moves easily to standing nearby enemies.
hud_and_control_optimizations.backpack_bullet_discarding: Initial discard quantity for merged bullets changed from half to 1 full stack (30 bullets).
hud_and_control_optimizations.item_pickup_behavior: Picking up a throwable while unarmed no longer automatically forces switching to hold the throwable.
hud_and_control_optimizations.weapon_switching: Weapon switching allowed while jumping (excluding tire jumps and falling states).
hud_and_control_optimizations.animation_adjustments: Running head position raised when holding Katana or Scythe.
hud_and_control_optimizations.sonia_orion_controls: Buffered firing inputs execute immediately once skill restriction ends.

lobby_network_ping_indicator.pop_up_prompts: Triggers mandatory confirmation pop-up for team leader and members before matchmaking if ping is poor.

ui_and_system_features.in_match_compass: Displays teammate directions on top HUD compass.
ui_and_system_features.emotes: Movement-based emotes can no longer be interrupted by sprinting.
ui_and_system_features.graphics_optimization: Low FPS warning offers a one-tap option to auto-apply recommended graphics/FPS quality.

team_up_and_booking.play_again_button: Available on spectator screen, Booyah screen, and post-match results page.
team_up_and_booking.cross_team_invites: Allows sending invites/bookings to players currently in another squad.
team_up_and_booking.leader_transfer: Leader title can be manually transferred; squad no longer disbands if leader leaves.
team_up_and_booking.booking_slots: Max 3 active booking slots; booked players auto-join post-match.
